# Local CCTV sample footage

Add only footage you own or are licensed to use, using these filenames:

- `road.mp4`
- `highway.mp4`
- `home_gate.mp4`
- `parking.mp4`
- `warehouse.mp4`
- `office.mp4`

The ManPro AI dashboard automatically plays the matching file in a muted, looping live-feed view. Restarting Vite is not required after adding a file; refresh the browser page.
